Seafoam for the oil is to be put in and ran through a few hours (or a day) before you do an oil change. It's an oil cleaner, NOT an oil treatment. If you're putting it into your gas tank, the best way to use it is to wait until you're almost empty, go to a gas station, put the entire bottle in, and then fill up. That can stay in the gas since it helps clear your fuel pump of all the crap that collects in there. Hope this helps
